description: Three 5,000-gallon above-ground tanks storing Class IB flammable liquid (hexane) lack secondary containment. Containment berm was breached in 2024 flood and never repaired. NFPA 30 requires secondary containment equal to 110% of largest tank volume.

Reactor R-3 pressure relief valve last tested 2021; required annual recertification per ASME Section VIII. Gauge reads 95% of MAWP under normal operating conditions, leaving minimal safety margin. No bypass valve lockout in place.

Oxidizer (sodium chlorate, 500 kg) stored adjacent to organic solvent drum rack within 2 meters. OSHA 29 CFR 1910.106 requires segregation. No spill containment between the two areas; a single spill event could initiate rapid oxidation.

Polypropylene dust accumulation measured at 1/8 inch depth on horizontal structural members above extrusion Line 4. NFPA 654 requires housekeeping when dust layer exceeds 1/32 inch. Dust collector filter change log shows 14-month gap.
Spill containment kit at Loading Dock D is expired (absorbent pads >3 years old, degraded packaging). Not immediately life-safety but reduces first-response capability for minor chemical releases.
Hazardous materials inventory (Tier II report) on file does not reflect hexane tanks added to Tank Farm Area 2 in Q3 2025. EPCRA Section 312 requires annual update.
